verdict: Intuitive's revenue jumped 22% to $3.05B as da Vinci procedures grew 14% — but a $450M antitrust settlement charge cut GAAP net income to $523M; without the charge, profit was about $1.05B.

segments.name: Instruments & accessories
segments.note: The single-use tools and accessories consumed by every robotic procedure — the recurring engine, growing with procedure volume.

segments.name: Systems
segments.note: Selling and leasing da Vinci and Ion robots: 546 da Vinci systems placed in the quarter, 291 of them under leases.

segments.name: Services
segments.note: Service contracts keeping an installed base of 12,094 da Vinci systems (and 1,152 Ion systems) running.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and support plus the back office — this quarter it also carries a $455M litigation charge for settling an antitrust class action.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing the next robots, instruments and imaging.

otherDetail: Interest and other income, net — Intuitive earns interest on its large cash and investment pile.

takeaways.title: Procedure growth is the story
takeaways.text: Worldwide procedures grew about 15% (da Vinci +14%, Ion +31%), pulling instrument revenue up 18% and expanding the installed base 12% to 12,094 systems.

takeaways.title: One charge halved GAAP profit
takeaways.text: Settling antitrust class-action litigation cost $450M before tax ($347M, or $0.99 a share, after tax). Non-GAAP net income, which excludes it, rose to $1.05B from $867M.

takeaways.title: Buybacks at full speed
takeaways.text: Intuitive repurchased 7.8 million shares for $2.94B in the quarter — more than five times its GAAP net income.

oneTimers: A $450M pre-tax charge (inside SG&A, which shows $455M of litigation charges) to settle previously disclosed antitrust class-action litigation; $347M after tax, or $0.99 per share.
Cost of revenue includes a $28M benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds for tariffs paid in prior periods ($22M of benefit to net income after tax).
footerNote: Net income attributable to Intuitive was $523M after $2M attributable to a joint-venture partner; the $1.49 EPS is on the attributable figure. Figures are rounded to $M; services revenue and cost of revenue absorb $1M rounding differences so the lines add exactly.
